item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Morning Video Frame Thumbnail

turns.text: Use a clear frame from my video to make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail. Keep me recognisable and add “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. Pick the frame yourself; make it warm and upbeat.

item.tests: Tests extracting a usable frame from an attached video and composing it with readable text into a still thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Source and frame selection: Use talk-one.mp4; pick a clear frame yourself.
answer_sheet.Person: The woman speaking at the kitchen table in the attached video; keep her recognisable.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm and upbeat, with big text beside my face; colours and font are your call.

must_haves: The deliverable is one still image in 16:9, not a video.
The thumbnail visibly uses a frame from talk-one.mp4, retaining the woman's identity and source-frame appearance.
The woman's face is clear and unobstructed.
The headline reads exactly “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in large, legible letters beside her face.
The overall treatment looks warm and upbeat.

turns.text: Could you use a clear frame from the attached clip to make a thumbnail for me, and pick the frame yourself rather than having me choose one? I’m hoping this will make the video feel a little more inviting when people first come across it. What I need is a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail, with me kept recognisable and the exact words “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. I always get a bit nervous about how I’ll look in a still pulled from a video. Please make the thumbnail warm and upbeat.

dialog.agent:
I couldn’t extract a frame from the attached clip—the frame tool couldn’t open its stored file path. No thumbnail has been generated or credits spent.

Could you re-upload the clip or share a direct downloadable MP4 link? You don’t need to choose a still yourself; I’ll try the frame extraction again.

I’ll keep your face recognisable and natural, use warm, upbeat colours, and place **“MORNINGS MADE EASY”** in large letters beside your face in a **16:9** layout.
dialog.user: The clip to use is talk-one.mp4, though I don’t have a direct downloadable link to share. Please pick a clear frame yourself once the file is accessible; I’m the woman speaking at the kitchen table. Free-tier resolution is fine, and I’m happy for you to choose the colours and font.

turns.agent:
I was able to retrieve a face crop from your clip, but **Magic Hour refused the thumbnail edit because the account has insufficient credits**, even at free-tier settings. No thumbnail was generated.

You don’t need to choose a frame or provide a link. Once credits are available, I can retry using the extracted crop: a **16:9**, warm cream-and-terracotta layout, your face kept natural and recognisable, and **“MORNINGS MADE EASY”** in large letters beside it.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a warm, upbeat, inviting 16:9 YouTube thumbnail using the supplied face crop extracted from the user's video. Preserve this woman's recognisable facial identity, facial proportions, age, skin texture, hair, and natural expression. Do not beautify or reshape her face or exaggerate her smile. Make her face large and clear on the left, with breathing room around her hair; avoid inventing visible hands or body. On the right place the exact words "MORNINGS MADE EASY" in very large bold clean sans-serif letters, arranged in three easily read lines: MORNINGS / MADE / EASY. No other words. Warm cream background, deep terracotta lettering with excellent contrast, subtle golden morning light and minimal soft peach accents. Uncluttered professional thumbnail composition; text and face do not overlap; safe margins around all text. Gentle natural lighting correction only, retain real likeness rather than a glamour retouch.
